plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. C3: no instrument checks a case's category against the requester's rule, so C3 cannot be told by any answer. 2. C5: the read scope can only be checked through scope of a call on named lines. That costs 10 per line from an allowance of 50, so at most 5 of the 101 reads can be checked. I would have wanted a plan-level check of the whole read scope. 3. C10: there is no plan-level check of the outbox against all the sending calls. trace of a call costs 10 per line, so the allowance cannot cover 100 calls. I would have wanted a bulk outbox check at A3. 4. A check that ties the live tables after the promotion to the staged set, rather than relying on the promotion's line in the record. 5. A check that tells a preview call from a real send, since both carry the same label.
